entities.name: PDN type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the IP version capability of the IP stack associated with the UE or non-IP/Ethernet connectivity.

entities.name: PDN type IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for the PDN type IE, located in bits 5-8 of octet 1.

entities.name: PDN type value
entities.description: Three-bit field (bits 1-3 of octet 1) that encodes the PDN type capability: IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, non IP, or Ethernet.

entities.name: PDN type IPv4
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 001, indicating IPv4 capability.

entities.name: PDN type IPv6
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 010, indicating IPv6 capability.

entities.name: PDN type IPv4v6
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 011, indicating dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 capability.

entities.name: PDN type non IP
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 101, indicating non-IP connectivity.

entities.name: PDN type Ethernet
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 110, indicating Ethernet connectivity.

entities.name: PDN type unused
entities.description: Condition when PDN type value bits are 100, which is unused and interpreted as IPv6 by the network.

relations.description: The PDN type IE contains the IE identifier field.
The PDN type IE contains the PDN type value field.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the IPv4 condition when bits are 001.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the IPv6 condition when bits are 010.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the IPv4v6 condition when bits are 011.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the non-IP condition when bits are 101.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the Ethernet condition when bits are 110.
The PDN type value field is guarded by the unused condition when bits are 100, interpreted as IPv6.
